baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction 'يسجد من في السماوات والأرض طوعا وكرها' assigns one prostrating relation to every agent while retaining two modes of undergoing it.
baseline_models.mechanism: God is the sole recipient; abasement reaches every agent in both realms. Willing compliance and aversive or compelled compliance alter the subject's stance, not the reach of the prostration.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the worshipped identify God as the sole recipient of the universal relation.
Lowering and abasement supply the common act imposed across both realms.
Obedient yielding supplies the willing mode of the same act.
Aversion to a thing supplies resistance without escape from the act.
Compelling another into what is disliked supplies the coerced mode of submission.

changed_reading.before: Prostration belongs chiefly to willing worshippers, with unwilling beings outside the act.
changed_reading.after: Every agent is already within prostration; willingness and resistance distinguish how that universal relation is borne.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposed locations 'السماوات والأرض' stand inside the scope of one downward act.
baseline_models.mechanism: The highest and lowest spatial poles are not merely an exhaustive merism. Prostration turns their vertical opposition into a leveling mechanism: what is elevated bends together with what is below.

activation_trace.role: Height and elevation supply the upper pole that the prostrating construction brings low.
The lower realm opposite heaven supplies the grounded pole of the leveling relation.
Bending and lowering the head provide the directional reversal from height toward ground.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth merely say that the subject set is exhaustive.
changed_reading.after: Their high-low opposition performs the claim: no elevation remains vertically exempt from being brought low before God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated phrase 'وظلالهم' gives shadows grammatical participation, followed by the temporal pair 'بالغدو والآصال'.
baseline_models.mechanism: A standing body's cast shadow becomes a visible co-subject that repeatedly bends or stretches along the ground. Morning and evening make this involuntary witness recurrent rather than decorative.

activation_trace.role: Bending and inclination give the cast shadow a visible prostrating geometry.
The shadow of a standing object supplies a bodily double that can enact what its owner resists.
Going at the opening of day supplies the first recurring endpoint of the shadow's motion.
Evening time supplies the opposite endpoint that makes the witness cyclical.

changed_reading.before: The shadows are a poetic appendage to the real subjects' worship.
changed_reading.after: The shadows are separately coordinated material witnesses whose daily geometry discloses submission even when the owner is unwilling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The shadow's timed bow becomes the downstream optical effect of subordinated luminaries that run on a bounded course within managed order.

activation_trace.role: The cast shadow supplies the focus phenomenon whose changing geometry needs a driver.
Subduing and directing something toward a purpose makes celestial service the causal frame.
The sun supplies the light source that casts and moves the focus shadow.
Continuous running supplies the motion transmitted into the shadow's changing angle.
A fixed temporal limit supplies bounded scheduling rather than random movement.
Managing an affair by regard for its outcome supplies the ordering intelligence behind the sequence.

structural_cues: 13:2 sequences celestial subjection, running to a term, and management before the focus presents timed shadows.
13:15 coordinates those shadows with all prostrating agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies subordinated luminaries, bounded motion, management, and timed cast shadows; I infer that luminary motion causes the shadow gesture and makes it an index of governance. A live alternative is that luminaries and shadows are parallel signs without an emphasized causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: The shadow happens to resemble a bow at two devotional times.
changed_reading.after: Its timed bow is a readable instrument of governed celestial motion, so ordinary optics visibly executes cosmic submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal submission acquires locally proportioned form: shadows contract and grow under measure, as descending water becomes differently shaped flow in each valley.

activation_trace.role: The cast shadow supplies a variable extension tied to a particular standing body and place.
Decrease and diminution supply the contracting phase of the shadow's daily measure.
Increase and growth supply the expanding phase of that measure.
A quantity reaching its proper limit makes contraction and growth calibrated rather than arbitrary.
Flowing floodwater supplies a mobile form that changes while obeying one descent.
A valley as the flood's channel supplies local capacity that shapes a universal input.
Each valley's measure supplies the analogy for each shadow's proportioned geometry.

structural_cues: 13:8 orders decrease, increase, and measure.
13:17 places measured valleys beneath descent from the sky.
13:15 places shadows between morning and evening endpoints.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured decrease and increase, capacity-shaped flow, and time-varying shadows; I transfer the measure-and-channel relation to shadow length. The alternative is that the measurements concern separate domains and only reinforce divine precision generally.

changed_reading.before: All shadows perform one visually uniform bow.
changed_reading.after: The act is universal but not geometrically uniform; each body, place, and hour receives a proportioned form of submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The daylight shadow is a periodic disclosure of a relation that also belongs to the hidden register. Its nighttime absence from sight does not suspend the universal claim.

activation_trace.role: The cast shadow supplies the visible trace whose appearance depends on light.
What is screened from eyes supplies the unseen register in which submission can remain real.
A witnessing mark supplies the shadow's epistemic function as evidence rather than the whole act.
Concealment supplies the nighttime mode in which the visible trace recedes.
Going openly along an earthly path supplies the daylight body whose shadow becomes legible.
Day opening through light supplies the condition that manifests the shadow witness.

structural_cues: 13:9 pairs the hidden and witnessed under one knower.
13:10 equalizes secret and open speech, then night concealment and day movement.
13:15 names only morning and evening manifestations without restricting the universal subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden/witnessed and night/day pairs plus a light-dependent shadow; I infer that visibility discloses submission rather than creates it. Alternatively, the pairs may only state exhaustive knowledge and leave shadow ontology untouched.

changed_reading.before: The visible shadow is itself the complete act of prostration.
changed_reading.after: The shadow is a timed witness to an underlying submission that remains within divine knowledge when no trace is visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fear and hope arise together before one lightning display, while thunder's physical disturbance itself glorifies. The willing/unwilling pair can therefore name co-present affective modes within one governed system, not only two fixed classes of beings.

activation_trace.role: Obedient yielding supplies the receptive pole sharpened by hope.
Aversion supplies the resistant pole sharpened by fear.
Anticipatory fear supplies an aversive response to the same displayed phenomenon.
Hopeful desire supplies a receptive response co-present with fear.
Weight opposed to lightness gives the cloud a material burden that still participates in order.
Worship through glorification identifies nonhuman activity as devotional participation.
Movement and disturbance make thunder's physical behavior part of its praise.
Praise opposed to blame gives the disturbance an affirmative orientation.

structural_cues: 13:12 places fear and hope side by side before lightning and heavy clouds.
13:13 immediately attributes praise to thunder and fear to angels.
13:15 likewise coordinates willingness and aversion within one universal predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired affects and nonhuman praise; I infer that they model simultaneous modes of one submission and that physical disturbance can itself praise. The alternative is a simple division of observers into fearful and hopeful groups.

changed_reading.before: Willingly and unwillingly sort creation into two stable populations.
changed_reading.after: They can also be simultaneous registers within one event: reception and resistance coexist while the material process still performs praise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The futile hand stretches toward water but cannot make it reach the mouth; the shadow stretches downward and reaches the ground without grasping. Prostration becomes an anti-grasping geometry of received alignment.

activation_trace.role: Downward bending supplies the successful direction of the focus gesture.
The cast shadow supplies an extension that reaches ground without the owner's control.
Extending the hand supplies the competing human geometry of attempted acquisition.
The literal palm localizes the failed reaching gesture in the body.
Actual water supplies the desired object that remains physically out of achieved relation.
Arrival at a goal supplies the explicitly negated outcome of the grasping motion.
The open mouth supplies the unreached endpoint against which the shadow's ground contact is read.

structural_cues: 13:14 stages an extended palm, water, an intended mouth, and repeated failure to reach.
13:15 follows with shadows extended along the ground in a successful downward relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed forward reaching and successful-looking downward shadow extension; I infer a reversal from grasping to receptive alignment. The live alternative is that 13:14 concerns false invocation only and offers no intended spatial contrast with shadows.

changed_reading.before: Prostration is simply a posture of lowering.
changed_reading.after: It also opposes acquisitive reach: the shadow attains its relation by being cast downward, while the grasping hand cannot force arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ontological submission is universal under overpowering divine rule, but ethical response remains differentiated. Answering, fulfilling, breaking, cutting, and commanded worship determine moral stance inside an inescapable prostrating order.

activation_trace.role: Universal abasement supplies the ontological condition shared by all agents.
Obedient yielding supplies the ethically affirmative way to inhabit that condition.
Aversion supplies the resistant way to inhabit the same unavoidable condition.
Comparison for equality explicitly blocks universal submission from becoming moral equivalence.
Overpowering from above and humbling below grounds the inescapable ontological layer.
Answering speech supplies the divergent human response that receives distinct outcomes.
Completion without deficiency supplies faithful enactment within universal submission.
Undoing a bound structure supplies active breach rather than escape from divine order.
Severing a connection supplies the social form of resistant agency.
Humble worship and obedience specify the commanded chosen form of the focus prostration.

structural_cues: 13:16 denies equality across blindness and sight, darkness and light, while naming the One Overpowering.
13:18 distinguishes responders from nonresponders.
13:20-25 contrast fulfilling and joining with breaking and cutting.
13:36 turns submission into an explicit command to worship God without partnership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal prostration alongside repeated evaluative contrasts and chosen acts; I infer two layers, unavoidable ontological submission and accountable ethical response. The alternative is that 'willingly and unwillingly' already exhausts the distinction without a layered model.

changed_reading.before: If everyone prostrates, willing and unwilling subjects are finally equivalent.
changed_reading.after: Everyone is ontologically under God, yet response remains morally consequential: universal submission is the field within which obedience and breach diverge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Against imagined spectacular transformations of mountain, earth, and dead, the focus presents an ordinary transformation already occurring every day. The moving shadow is mundane creation answering the affair that wholly belongs to God.

activation_trace.role: The everyday cast shadow supplies the low-visibility sign contrasted with demanded spectacle.
Daily morning recurrence makes the sign available without exceptional rupture.
Removal and displacement supply the imagined spectacular movement of mountains.
A high solid mass supplies the resistant object imagined as moved.
Severing supplies the imagined rupture of the earth.
Intelligible speech linking speakers supplies the imagined animation of the dead.
Loss of life supplies the apparently least responsive subject imagined as speaking.
The affair or state belonging wholly to God gathers all imagined and ordinary responsiveness under one ownership.

structural_cues: 13:31 stacks three counterfactual spectacles and then assigns the whole affair to God.
13:15 offers recurrent shadow movement rather than a rupture of ordinary material order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spectacular counterfactuals and a daily shadow event; I infer a contrast in evidentiary scale, with ordinary optics already enacting responsiveness. Alternatively, 13:31 may not look back to shadows and may only answer demands for miracles.

changed_reading.before: Shadow prostration is a minor natural illustration beside genuinely miraculous responsiveness.
changed_reading.after: Its ordinariness is the point: creation visibly answers divine order every day without mountains moving or the dead speaking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The One standing over every self and its acquisitions creates a vertical counterpoint to each standing body's prostrating shadow. The demand to name partners tests whether labels or outward claims can produce any rival agency.

activation_trace.role: The shadow of a standing object supplies the accountable self's involuntary bodily witness.
Bodily standing supplies the vertical posture set over against the shadow's bow.
Guardianship and oversight supply the divine standing-over relation that makes the shadow evidentiary.
The very self supplies the individually accountable owner of the witnessing shadow.
Acquisition supplies the actions over which each self is watched.
Naming as designation supplies the challenge to give alleged partners more than verbal identity.
Outward appearance supplies the rival register of claims that lack material agency.
Partnership with God supplies the denied alternative ownership under which the shadow might bow elsewhere.

structural_cues: 13:33 opens with standing over every self according to what it earns.
It then challenges the naming of partners and contrasts knowledge with outward speech.
13:15 makes the shadow of each standing subject bow to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oversight, individual acquisition, naming, appearance, and a standing body's shadow; I infer a spatial accountability image and that names cannot create rival agency. The alternative is that the standing and naming clauses are polemical units with no intended link to shadow geometry.

changed_reading.before: The shadow is generic evidence that creation belongs to God.
changed_reading.after: It is also each accountable self's body-bound witness: the person stands and earns under oversight while the attached shadow denies every merely named rival.

context_deltas.mechanism: Worldly shadow testifies through timed change, while paradisal shade testifies through permanence beside continuous flow. Submission therefore has more than one material grammar: recurring motion and stable shelter coexist.

activation_trace.role: The cast shadow of a standing object supplies the changing worldly mode.
Morning movement supplies one temporal edge of worldly variation.
Evening supplies the other edge that marks recurrence rather than stasis.
Stillness and duration supply the unbroken mode of the promised environment.
Shade as covering supplies stable shelter rather than the moving double of a body.
Continuous river flow shows that permanence can contain motion without loss of order.

structural_cues: 13:15 bounds cast shadows by morning and evening.
13:35 coordinates permanent provision and shade with rivers that flow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies changing timed shadows, lasting shade, and continuous flow; I infer two coexisting material modes of ordered submission. Alternatively, the later shade may be reward imagery without revising the focus's cast-shadow mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A shadow witnesses submission only by visibly moving and lengthening.
changed_reading.after: Changing cast shadow is one mode, not the definition; permanent shelter can also embody ordered dependence while motion continues around it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The daily shadow can be read as a surface trace repeatedly erased and fixed, while the earth is approached through diminishing edges. Morning and evening then write a revisable boundary whose governing judgment is itself firm.

activation_trace.role: The cast shadow supplies the transient surface mark that can appear, shift, and vanish.
Erasure as disappearance of a trace supplies the shadow's vanishing phase.
Duration and fixation supply the contrasting phase in which a trace holds.
Ordered written characters supply the script analogy for successive shadow positions.
Loss of part of a thing supplies the recession of a marked extent.
An edge or endpoint supplies the boundary from which diminution becomes visible.
Firm precision supplies the stable governance beneath changing surface boundaries.

structural_cues: 13:39 juxtaposes erasing, fixing, and the source book.
13:41 depicts the earth diminished from its edges and closes with unreviewable judgment.
13:15 supplies a trace whose boundary changes across the day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trace erasure, fixation, writing, edge diminution, and timed shadows; I infer that shadow positions behave like a daily boundary script. The live alternative is that this is only a cross-domain material analogy and should not be treated as an intended image.

changed_reading.before: Morning and evening merely locate two observations of the same shadow.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are phases in a daily inscription: an edge is fixed, diminished, and erased while stable rule remains underneath.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س ط ع mapping rather than the ordinary ط و ع sense. It remains anchored to focus word 7 and coheres with cast shadow and daybreak; downstream prose should present it only as an optical echo, never as replacement morphology or a disambiguated gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping attached to 'طوعا' includes extension and rising in air, inside a focus scene organized by shadows and daybreak.

activation_trace.role: Extension and elevation through air supply an optical undertone inside the volitional term.
The cast shadow supplies the surface on which extended light becomes visible by contrast.
The opening of day supplies the temporal emergence of that light-shadow geometry.

changed_reading.before: 'Willingly' contributes only an inner psychology of consent.
changed_reading.after: As a contained optical echo, willingness also rides the spreading light that makes involuntary shadow-prostration visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because tribute is a remote branch within the focus root for prostration. It remains anchored to 'يسجد' and to the explicit willing/compelled split; render it as a juridical analogy of total jurisdiction, not as the lexical meaning of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines a prostration root whose inventory includes tribute with willing and compelled modes before God.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped recipient supplies the sole sovereign to whom acknowledgment is rendered.
Tribute associated with submission supplies the juridical image of acknowledgment exacted under rule.
Obedient yielding supplies freely rendered allegiance.
Compulsion into what is disliked supplies acknowledgment extracted despite resistance.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes only ritual posture or natural inclination.
changed_reading.after: As a contained legal analogy, universal sovereignty receives allegiance freely from some and exacts unavoidable acknowledgment from others.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the low, still gaze branch of prostration to the packet's form-distant و س م mapping for 'السماوات'. It remains anchored in focus words 2, 5, and 9 and is reinforced by the witnessed-mark cue; render it as a readerly posture or secondary sign mechanism, not as a lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can place a lowered sustained gaze upon shadows, while a split inventory supplies the visible mark by which a condition is inferred.

activation_trace.role: Sustained looking with a lowered, still eye supplies the reader's posture toward ground-level evidence.
A visible mark from which an observer infers a condition makes the scene legible as evidence.
The standing object's shadow supplies the specific ground-level mark being watched.
A witnessing sign reinforces the shadow's role as a mark that discloses an otherwise hidden relation.

changed_reading.before: The reader observes other beings performing prostration.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the verse also lowers the reader's gaze so the shadow can be read as a witnessing mark of hidden submission.

strongest_changes: Timed shadows became downstream instruments of governed celestial motion rather than decorative similes.
Universal prostration split into unavoidable ontological submission and ethically differentiated response.
The visible shadow became a measured, periodic disclosure of hidden submission rather than the whole act.
Changing worldly cast shadow and permanent paradisal shade preserved two coexisting material modes of ordered dependence.
summary.what_was_special: Split mappings and ordered context sequences activated optical, epistemic, affective, juridical, and boundary-script readings without forcing them into one interpretation. The most productive surprise was that an involuntary shadow can be both a causal effect of governed light and an accountable body's visible witness.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 'وظلالهم' makes shadows independent co-subjects or signs of their owners' submission remains open.
Fear and hope may model simultaneous modes within one observer or separate groups.
The س ط ع and و س م activations are packet-authorized but form-distant and must remain secondary echoes.
The erasure and diminishing-edge model may be only a material analogy rather than an intended inter-ayah mechanism.
